# Link finding

## Links & media
- [Guide](https://example.com/guide)
- Bare link https://example.com/bare. And again https://example.com/bare.
- In parens (https://example.com/paren) and "https://example.com/quoted"
- Trailing punctuation https://example.com/path/x?a=1, then more!
- [Repeat](https://example.com/guide)
- Not a link: ftp://example.com/file and xhttps://example.com/glued
- Query https://example.com/q?x=1&y=2;
